entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA2263 fix incorrectly drops all parameters after 'type' when 'params' follows #53189

Closed

  • CA1708 is incorrectly reported for extension members #51716
  • dotnet format doesn't support the single csharp file #53174
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression] With NET11.0 preview 2 SDK, 'dotnet tool' command fails - Unhandled exception: Object reference not set to an instance of an object. #52905
  • dotnet watch fails when DOTNET_WATCH_AUTO_RELOAD_WS_PORT is set and TLS is supported (binds http and https to same port) #52908
